dct_description_sm:
Contains data and code associated with till Al availability modelling. This includes the till geochemistry shapefile and all necessary raster files for replication of the models, the code used model Al and generate the predictions and associated calibrated standard deviation, and results in raster form of predictions, standard deviation predictions and calibrated standard deviation predictions. 

The code can also be modified to suit other modelling ventures or uncertainty calibration.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Mapping and modelling a boreal forest soil organic carbon predictor in the glacial till of Newfoundland, Canada
pcdm_memberOf_sm: Biogeochemistry of Boreal Ecosystems Research Group
